structured.idPolicy: Harness-assigned identities, not collaborator IDs recorded in the trace. Same seed42/maybeRandomString 10-character client policy as IdListAlgorithm; one continuous ElementIdGenerator assigns client_sequence (base36) bunches and counters. Every non-anchor bunch is asserted new; a continuation must match both anchor.counter+1 and the generator's next counter. Start empty; never save/reload during replay. Checkpoint save() only observes state.

opaque8.idPolicy: Harness-assigned opaque 8-character IDs: collision-checked deterministic SHA256/base64url prefixes map EACH WHOLE generated structured bunch ID bijectively. Counters, run grouping, operation order, anchors and characters are identical to the structured replay. Not recorded collaborator identities; no refresh or regrouping.

methodology.idOnly: One uninterrupted clock around all operations, natural GC only. Common precomputed trace is retained during the loop and released before post-run memory. No per-operation timers or yields. Initialization, input preparation and final verification excluded.
methodology.editor: Incremental ProseMirror transaction for every operation, including paragraph split/join. Shared Fenwick paragraph mapping, anchor/target verification, ID-history maintenance, and two animation frames at each checkpoint are included. Elapsed time is the sum of five segments, not uninterrupted throughput. Forced GC and full reference verification are outside segment clocks.
methodology.identities: All containers receive the same precomputed identities per model. Actual insertion anchors/deletion targets are obtained through list.at inside timed operations and checked against the reference. Each insertion creates the same small ID object inside the clock; continuing a bunch reuses the actual anchor's bunchId string, matching generateAfter without a retained intern pool. Workload validation proves any non-continuing bunch is globally new. Identity-value generation is excluded for every candidate. Serialized trace input still creates common transient garbage.
methodology.memory: Heap plus backing storage after forced GC, minus prepared-page baseline measured before empty container/editor initialization. Trace chunks and expected states are released before observations. History retains prior 100 ID-list versions only, not ProseMirror undo. Before-GC samples are boundary observations, not peaks. releasedHistoryBytes is retained total after release; historyFreedBytes is the difference.
methodology.trials: Fresh browser process and context for every full replay. Browser launch/close are outside all clocks; browser version must remain unchanged. Three trials by default: report median and range, not p95. One initially empty document; separate from the four-preloaded-document load/session suite.
methodology.hostPressure: Per-job wall-clock timestamps and host 1/5/15-minute load averages are sampled outside all browser timers, before context creation and after final verification/collection. They are diagnostic context, not thermal measurements or grounds for automatic outlier removal.
